                                          ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Munieipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current B2-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 8-G in the area bounded by:

              a line 507.58 feet south of and parallel to West 32"'* Place; South Morgan Street; a
              line 554.08 feet south of and parallel to West 32"^ Place; and the public alley next
              west of and parallel to South Morgan Street

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.


SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
